overview_description.description:
Hipmob brings easy-to-use live chat, helpdesk, feedback, and customer engagement tools to mobile and tablet businesses. It serves from mobile-native startups to small businesses to large public companies with tools to increase sales and transform customer support.

Hipmob provides its clients with real-time contextual information about their customers, including devices, apps, operating systems, geographic info, and more. It was founded in 2012 by [Ayo Omojola](https://www.crunchbase.com/person/ayo-omojola) and is based in Palo Alto, C.A.
